documents.source_document: Document 5 — Adam Smith on the division of labour
documents.source_citation: Source: Adam Smith, The Wealth of Nations, 1776 (adapted)
documents.source_text: “[A worker alone] could scarce, perhaps, with his utmost industry, make one pin in a day. . . . The important business of making a pin is, in this manner, divided into about eighteen distinct operations. . . . I have seen a small manufactory [factory] of this kind where ten men only were employed. . . . Those ten persons, therefore, could make among them upwards of forty-eight thousand pins in a day.”
